title: Eid Outfit Ideas: Anarkali and Kurta Sets for Women Abroad
excerpt: Eid outfit ideas for women abroad: modest Anarkalis and kurta sets for Eid prayers, family lunch and evening dawats, with dupatta and layering tips.
body:
For Eid abroad, the most popular outfits are a floor-length Anarkali for the evening dawat and a comfortable embroidered kurta set for Eid prayers and family lunch, both worn with a dupatta that can cover your head. Choose soft greens, jewel blues, purples and whites, and pick a dupatta that drapes easily over your hair for the masjid.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz styling team, Jaipur. Our Anarkalis and kurta sets are stitched in our own Jaipur unit.*

**Quick answer**

- Eid prayers: a kurta set with a dupatta that covers your head comfortably
- Family lunch: an embroidered kurta set or a light Anarkali
- Evening dawat or Eid party: a taffeta or georgette Anarkali
- Modest styling: full-length kurtas, a lightweight dupatta and covered shoulders
- Eid dates follow the moon, so check your local masjid or calendar and order early

## What should I wear on Eid as a woman living abroad?

Eid often stretches across a full day, and sometimes over two or three. You might start with prayers at the masjid, visit family for lunch, and end with an evening dawat or a community Eid party. Many women abroad plan two outfits: a simpler one for the morning and a dressier one for the evening.

For the evening, a gota work Anarkali feels rich and celebratory. The [sage green taffeta silk Anarkali with sequin organza dupatta](/products/sage-green-taffeta-silk-gota-work-anarkali-suit-set-with-sequin-organza-dupatta/) is a lovely Eid choice. Green has a special place in Eid celebrations for many families, and sage is a soft, elegant way to wear it.

## Which outfit suits each part of Eid?

| Moment | Outfit | Fabric | Dupatta tip |
|---|---|---|---|
| Eid prayers | Embroidered kurta set | Cotton | Light dupatta over the head, pinned at one side |
| Family lunch | Kurta set or light Anarkali | Cotton, chiffon | Draped over both shoulders |
| Evening dawat | Taffeta or georgette Anarkali | Taffeta silk, georgette | Over one shoulder, or over the head for elders |
| Eid party | Anarkali with statement earrings | Georgette, chiffon | Pinned so it stays in place |
| Chand raat | Kurti with palazzos | Cotton | Optional |

## What should I wear to Eid prayers?

For prayers, comfort and modesty come first. You will be sitting, standing and bowing, so choose a kurta that moves easily and pants that are not too tight. A soft, light dupatta that stays in place when draped over your hair is ideal.

The [off-white embroidered cotton kurta set with cutwork organza dupatta](/products/off-white-embroidered-cotton-flex-kurta-pant-organza-dupatta-set/) is fresh and calm for the morning. White and off-white feel clean and peaceful for Eid prayers, and the embroidery keeps it festive for photos afterwards.

If the dupatta is sheer, wear a thin hijab cap or inner scarf underneath so it covers fully. Our post on [what to wear to a Nikah or Walima](/blog/what-to-wear-to-a-nikah-or-walima-as-a-guest/) has more tips on modest dupatta draping.

## Which Anarkali is best for an Eid dawat?

For an evening dawat with family and friends, choose an Anarkali with rich colour and a little shine.

### Royal blue for a classic look

The [royal blue georgette Anarkali with gota lace dupatta](/products/royal-blue-georgette-anarkali-suit-gota-handwork-dupatta/) is regal and photographs beautifully. Georgette drapes softly and is comfortable for long evenings.

### Purple bandhani for colour and movement

The [purple bandhani chiffon Anarkali with hand-embroidered neckline](/products/purple-bandhani-chiffon-anarkali-suit-set/) is light, flowing and joyful. It suits an Eid party where you might be hosting or moving around a lot.

Browse more styles on our [Anarkali suits](/anarkali-suits-online-usa-uk/) page.

> **From our Jaipur studio:** Gota work is made by stitching thin metallic ribbon onto fabric in patterns. It shines softly rather than sparkling, which makes it feel festive but still graceful for family gatherings and religious occasions.

## How do I style an Eid outfit in a cold or hot country?

If Eid falls in a cold season where you live, wear a long coat over your outfit and thermal leggings underneath. A wool shawl over the dupatta keeps you warm on the walk to the masjid. In the UAE or Australia in warmer months, choose cotton and chiffon, and keep layers light. Indoor venues in Dubai can be heavily air-conditioned, so a light shawl is handy. Our guide to [Indian wedding guest outfits in Dubai](/blog/indian-wedding-guest-outfits-in-dubai-and-abu-dhabi/) covers dressing for UAE heat and AC.

## When should I order for Eid?

Because Eid follows the moon sighting, the exact day can shift. Plan around the expected week and order made-to-measure at least 3–4 weeks before. ## Our pick for you

For prayers, the off-white kurta set. For the evening, the sage green Anarkali or the royal blue georgette Anarkali. For a lively Eid party, the purple bandhani. A small etiquette note: when visiting elders, a dupatta over the head or shoulders is a respectful touch.

## Frequently asked questions

**What colour is good for Eid?**
Green, white, blue, purple and soft pastels are all popular for Eid. Choose what feels joyful and suits your skin tone.

**Can I wear an Anarkali for Eid prayers?**
Yes, if it is comfortable for sitting and bowing. Many women prefer a kurta set for prayers and an Anarkali for the evening.

**How do I keep my dupatta in place over my head?**
Wear a thin inner cap or scarf underneath and pin the dupatta at one side. Light fabrics stay in place more easily.

**How should I care for a taffeta Anarkali after Eid?**
Dry clean it, then store it folded in a cotton bag with the gota work turned inwards, away from damp.
